name: Aybek Yamamoto-Darko
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Aybek Yamamoto-Darko are average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 25, their face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on deman — and they make no effort to hide it.

They used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Aybek Yamamoto-Darko plans to keep it that way. They work as a surveillance specialist out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Aybek Yamamoto-Darko operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Aybek Yamamoto-Darko can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Aybek Yamamoto-Darko a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A dead drop Aybek Yamamoto-Darko maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Aybek Yamamoto-Darko's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Aybek Yamamoto-Darko functions as a connector — their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand. Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.heritage: Japanese / Eastern European (Turkic) with undetermined tertiary lineages
physical_description.build: Lean and economical—muscle distributed for endurance rather than bulk. Movements suggest compressed efficiency, as if they've learned to occupy minimal space despite their psychological presence.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with deliberate silver threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Asymmetrical undercut; longer on one side (covers scarring), shorter on the other for visibility and counterbalance
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertones—natural, unreplaced
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm beige undertone with olive cast, reflecting mixed Asian and Central Asian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, narrow jaw, skin maintained with clinical precision—minimal scarring except where deliberately hidden. Expression defaults to neutral observation. Eyes move constantly; they are always recording.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from left temple to jawline, partially obscured by longer hair on that side, suggesting facial reconstruction or trauma removal
Thin pale line across the right wrist—self-inflicted or combat-related, deliberately left unhealed
Faint tattooed circuit pattern along the inside of left forearm—custom work, non-standard design, possibly ritual or identification marker
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome synthesizer port at the base of the neck—roughly the size of a thumb, visible when head is tilted or hair is swept back. The port has a matte gunmetal finish with subtle wear marks. No visible respiratory augmentation; lungs are replaced internally and undetectable. The overall aesthetic suggests someone who doesn't bother hiding what they are.
physical_description.posture_movement: Still when stationary—genuinely still, not the tense stillness of anxiety but the economical stillness of predatory focus. Moves with controlled precision, weight always centered and ready. Hands at rest are never fully relaxed; fingers maintain micro-movements suggesting constant sensory processing. Eyes scan spaces methodically before settling. Speech patterns shift between clipped efficiency and unexpected verbosity, depending on context.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear with personal modifications. Matte black layered jacket (Kessler brand knockoff, reinforced at stress points) over grey utility vest with asymmetrical pockets and cable anchors. Dark fitted pants with cargo modifications and reinforced knee panels. Worn tactical boots with custom grip sole. Thermal-responsive base layers visible at collar and wrists. No logos or corporate affiliation visible. Jewelry minimal—only a worn brass ring on right index finger, possibly a ritual object or timer. Functional, forgettable, designed not to register as either wealthy or desperate.
